meta.name: craft-content-modeling
meta.description: Craft CMS 5 content modeling — sections, entry types, fields, Matrix, relations, project config, and content architecture strategy. Covers everything editors and developers need to structure content in Craft: choosing section types, designing entry types and field layouts, selecting field types for specific needs, configuring Matrix and nested entries, setting up relations and eager loading, and planning multi-site propagation.
